name: Glare
source:
After answering the company questionnaire, a maid robot named Glare is shipped to you in a cardboard box.
You talk with her and pursue the truth behind her delivery.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/834150/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
回答完公司的问卷后，一个名为Glare的女仆机器人会装在一个纸板箱里运送给你。
你与她交谈并追查她分娩背后的真相。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/834150/]Steam[/url]]
